text:
sam: Heads-up: telemetry clearinghouse sprint sync. Need to confirm owners and blockers for token-cost attribution + latency breakdown before we cut the canary.

tara: Quick question— who owns the attribution join for billing exports? I thought @miguel but want to lock it.

miguel: I own the ETL join + attribution rules. Target: finish transform by EOD Wed. Blocker: need model_variant codes (quantized vs fp16) from infra to map cost buckets.

sam: @miguel yep. @infra-team (cc @elaine) can we get the model-variant mapping by Tue? Also need token-per-request distro for latency sim.

elaine: On it. Mapping ETA Tue 10:00 PT. Token distro: we'll run a synthetic trace and drop a CSV to s3://redwood-telemetry/staging/token-distros/ and ping when done.

miguel: Great. After that I'll run local cost-attrib, then push a branch telemetry/attrib-miguel to analytics repo.

sam: Also need to confirm event schema change. Drafting minimal delta below please check.

sam: ```
# telemetry.event v2 additions
- attribute: model_variant (string)
- attribute: tokens_input (int)
- attribute: tokens_output (int)
- attribute: cost_estimate_usd (float)
- attribute: latency_ms (int)
```

tara: Looks reasonable. Two requests: 1) add attribution_version (string) for rollbacks, 2) clarify whether cost_estimate_usd is pre- or post-discount.

sam: Good call. I'll add attribution_version and mark cost_estimate_usd as "pre-discount, raw unit cost" in the PR body.

deploy-bot: canary-deploy started for analytics-pipeline at 1918765432. Status: queued.

miguel: Proposed rollout: dev -> staging canary (48h) -> prod canary (gradual 5% -> 25% -> 100%) over ~72h. Need eng-sre signoff on fallback.

tara: +1 to the cadence. eng-sre: any issues with 2d staging and 3d prod? Also suggest metric gates on token_cost_delta and p95 latency.

ops-bot: @eng-sre suggested gates: token_cost_delta < 8% AND p95_latency increase < 10% OR auto-rollback. Alerts to #incidents + on-call.

sam: Owners recap:
- Attribution ETL/join: miguel
- Model-variant mapping: elaine / infra-team
- Schema PR: sam (will open) with tara review
- Canary ops + fallback: eng-sre (on-call)

tara: I'll review the PR when opened. Small ask: include a sample event payload in the PR description.

sam: Will do. @miguel once you push your analytics diff tag the PR so the dq jobs run.

miguel: Will push Wed AM. One dependency left: billing rates table (rate-per-token). @alexa-billing can you confirm current rates + discount tiers?

alexa-billing: Billing team— rates stable for this month. We'll upload CSV to billing-sftp and post here by Tue 12:00. Will include volume tiers.

sam: Timeline:
- Tue 10:00 PT: infra/elaine posts model-variant mapping
- Tue 12:00: billing posts rates CSV
- Wed EOD: miguel finishes ETL transform and opens branch
- Tue AM: sam opens schema PR (will tag reviewers)
- Thu: start staging canary
- Next Mon: prod canary rollout begins (per plan)

If anyone can't meet these windows speak up now.

tara: All good from product. :thumbsup:

miguel: Small QA request: can we get a sample of prod traces with token-level breakdowns so I can validate latency attribution logic?

eng-sre-bot: Traces access request submitted for miguel. ETA ~4 hours. Use the redwood-secrets role.

sam: Thanks everyone. I'll open the PR, add a checklist, and post here when canary goes live. :rocket:
